An Indian district courtroom after hours, a wooden witness box, a raised bench, files tied with red string, ceiling fans, light through shutters. Wide panoramic composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same scene carries on, quieter and darker: open sky, distance and shadow, nothing important there, one continuous picture with no panels and no split. Painted by one hand in 1970s Indian pulp-novel gouache: thick opaque brushwork, deep night violet and indigo shadows, hot vermilion and marigold lamp light, painted paper grain, a slightly faded print, dramatic low angle, full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no signboards, no posters, no number plates, no writing anywhere.
